pages.text: With the possession of this new gem, I believe solely that this gem has no other purpose than that of transporting me to another realm, which although disappointing that I am unable to find a way to use it for weaponry and armor, I would be lying if I didn't said I am intrigued.
The charge frame for the respective charge, just like the other three.
This one asks for each of the properties and the original just for a single charge... they really don't want me in this realm do they?
